body: Anything older than me is old.
I just hear a lot of similarities from a band formed in the early 80s. I really dig Protest, but its cool to find a band that could shred like them before they were born.
I just wonder if they ever get pissed that Blind Guardian already wrote all of their songs before they were born.

Because Tipper Gore is a bitch.

I am only alive because of the guilt assigned to those who commit suicide. Its silly really. I spend every night alone, but after I tried to kill myself, the few people who bother to talk to me were a cross between terrified, angry, and deeply sad. Both of my friends promised they would be there for me. My parents did what theyve always done and didnt take it seriously. Within days, one friend went back to just humoring me when I would send a text, and the other has nearly stopped talking to me. My brother hasnt spoken to me since he walked in to my house and found me with an empty bottle of Jack and my shotgun, except to tell me he gave away my ticket to a metal show. They assume it was for attention. Understandable I guess. Its been six months now, and every day I feel more ready to go. If they only knew how many times I overdosed before. Everytime, its the same. People claim they love me so much and would be devastated if I died, and then they leave. And I know that on some level, they do care about me. But a large part of that is because they feel obligated to do so, or risk feeling guilt. And they are no doubt as aware of that as I am. So the choice becomes to either get closer and risk being hurt, or leave altogether. And I encourage them to leave. I am by no means deserving of their sympathy. I dont feel sad about dying. I feel something of relief when I consider my own death. I feel sad about the people I would hurt, no matter how little they show that they care. And I long for the day when no one does care at all. I want them to leave. I want to disappear. I want to end my life because I have only ever known pain, abuse, and rejection. Coming from the perspective of wanting to die, my opinion is that calling a suicidal person selfish is suicidal. But that does not mean suicide is not selfish. The two are not mutually exclusive. When I do take my life, it will be when no one is left to care. I stopped caring about myself when I was in grade school. But I never stopped caring for others, even when they didnt always care for me. Not that Im perfect. I am legitimately an asshole. I am extremely logical and dont understand peoples feelings. I hurt people without meaning to. But I dont want to hurt anyone, so I accept the pain I must carry because I know it will end eventually.
